hunt.justification: Identity-led breaches avoid zero-days and exploits, making them invisible to traditional vulnerability management. This hunt validates that even if credentials are stolen, subsequent abuse is detected.

scenario.summary: Threat actors leverage infostealer malware (Lumma, RedLine, Vidar) to harvest credentials and session cookies from personal or contractor devices, which are later sold via access brokers and Telegram channels. These stolen identities are used to bypass MFA via session replay or fatigue attacks to gain access to corporate cloud platforms like Snowflake, AWS, and Slack for large-scale data exfiltration and extortion.

meta.rationale: Start with users reporting 'false' for compliance in hb_auth_signin. Focus on servers and administrative workstations first. Widen the domain check if high exposure is found in Hudson Rock.
meta.hypothesis: An attacker has used stolen credentials harvested from unmanaged devices to bypass MFA via push fatigue, subsequently discovering cloud secrets and internal shares to exfiltrate data.

hunt.name: Identity-Led Cloud Abuse and Secret Discovery
hunt.description: This hunt follows the transition from compromised identity to resource abuse, as seen in the Snowflake and Uber breaches. It begins by scoping users signing in from non-compliant devices, then examines authentication patterns for MFA fatigue and proxy usage. The second phase correlates these suspicious logons with secret discovery in cloud control planes and administrative SMB shares, connecting initial access to malicious intent.

config.scoping_notes: Start with users reporting 'false' for compliance in hb_auth_signin. Focus on servers and administrative workstations first. Widen the domain check if high exposure is found in Hudson Rock.
config.beyond_detection: A rule fires on MFA failures. This hunt connects those failures to compliance state, underground exposure, and subsequent cloud discovery—providing the context required to justify account suspension.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, actor_user_name, provider, src_endpoint_ip, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE device_is_compliant = 'false' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Scope the estate to users and hosts accessing corporate resources from devices that do not meet management policy.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts and users signing in from personal or unmanaged machines. Silence suggests high compliance.

primitive_config.label: Identify non-compliant device sign-ins
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, actor_user_name, provider, src_endpoint_ip, time FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE device_is_compliant = 'false' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts and users signing in from personal or unmanaged machines. Silence suggests high compliance.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, SUM(CASE WHEN activity_id = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failures, SUM(CASE WHEN activity_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successes FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING failures >= 5 AND successes > 0 ORDER BY failures DESC
config.description: Detect many authentication failures followed by a success for a single user, indicating a push bombing attack.
config.expected_signal: A high count of failures followed by success. This is the primary indicator for the Uber-style compromise.

primitive_config.label: MFA push fatigue patterns
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip, SUM(CASE WHEN activity_id = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failures, SUM(CASE WHEN activity_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successes FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING failures >= 5 AND successes > 0 ORDER BY failures DESC
primitive_config.expected: A high count of failures followed by success. This is the primary indicator for the Uber-style compromise.

config.content: SELECT domain, total_stealers, last_employee_compromised FROM hudsonrock_search_by_domain WHERE domain = '{{target_domain}}'
config.description: Enrich the hunt by checking if the organizational domain has existing stealer log exposure.
config.expected_signal: Confirmed stealer log exposure for the domain, increasing the likelihood that recent sign-ins involve stolen material.

primitive_config.label: Check organizational exposure
primitive_config.content: SELECT domain, total_stealers, last_employee_compromised FROM hudsonrock_search_by_domain WHERE domain = '{{target_domain}}'
primitive_config.expected: Confirmed stealer log exposure for the domain, increasing the likelihood that recent sign-ins involve stolen material.

config.objective: Determine if sign-in patterns indicate a successful account takeover via credential theft or MFA fatigue.
config.description: Weigh compliance state, MFA patterns, and domain exposure to determine if an account was compromised.
config.expected_signal: A risk assessment per user citing the combination of unmanaged device use and MFA fatigue.
config.success_criteria: A per-user verdict (malicious | suspicious | benign) citing MFA success and exposure data.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, resource_type, resource_name, bytes_out, time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{secret_api_ops}}' || ',', ',' || api_operation || ',') > 0 OR bytes_out > 50000000) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY bytes_out DESC
config.description: Search Cloud API logs for secret-reading operations or large data transfers.
config.expected_signal: A user reading access keys, assuming roles, or downloading large amounts of data from S3 or similar services.

primitive_config.label: Cloud secret discovery and exfiltration
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, resource_type, resource_name, bytes_out, time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{secret_api_ops}}' || ',', ',' || api_operation || ',') > 0 OR bytes_out > 50000000) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY bytes_out DESC
primitive_config.expected: A user reading access keys, assuming roles, or downloading large amounts of data from S3 or similar services.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, share_name, file_name, device_hostname, time FROM hb_smb_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{sensitive_shares}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(share_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
config.description: Correlate identity access with discovery of backup files or credentials on administrative shares.
config.expected_signal: Users previously identified as high-risk accessing sensitive shares like ADMIN$ or backup locations.

primitive_config.label: Sensitive SMB share access
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, share_name, file_name, device_hostname, time FROM hb_smb_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{sensitive_shares}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(share_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') ORDER BY time DESC
primitive_config.expected: Users previously identified as high-risk accessing sensitive shares like ADMIN$ or backup locations.
